entities.name: Earl W. Vincent
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Earl W. Vincent was a Republican U.S. Representative from Iowa's 9th congressional district in 1928–29, a delegate to the Republican State convention in 1930, and was appointed judge of the fifth judicial district of Iowa in February 1945.
